epoch_indexing: one-based (epoch 1 = first pass through the dataset)

shrimpdb3.best_checkpoint_source: Ultralytics EarlyStopping log: "Best results observed at epoch 6, best model saved as best.pt."
shrimpdb3.early_stop_reason: patience=15 triggered: validation metric did not improve for 15 epochs after the best checkpoint at epoch 6; training stopped at epoch 21.
shrimpdb3.note: best_validation_checkpoint_epoch is taken from the Ultralytics EarlyStopping log message. The minimum val/loss epoch in results.csv is reported as a secondary signal only.

combined4.best_checkpoint_source: inferred from minimum val/loss across results.csv (Ultralytics did not emit an EarlyStopping message); the project does not record the exact best.pt epoch explicitly.

note: best_validation_checkpoint_epoch is determined from authoritative Ultralytics log evidence where available (ShrimpDB-3) and from results.csv minimum val/loss otherwise (Combined-4).
